# Astronomical image dependencies

CFITSIO: https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/fitsio/ (4.7.0 used for local validation).
LibRaw: https://www.libraw.org/ (0.22.2 used for local validation).
LibRaw is distributed under the CDDL alternative; the original copyright file
and CDDL license are included. Unmodified source is available from
https://www.libraw.org/download and the version in the package manager receipt.
The Mac distribution also carries dependency notices for OpenMP, LittleCMS
and libjpeg-turbo. They are bundled as shared libraries by the packaging script.
